cursor.note: PROVED: a-probe-reads-the-tree-the-face-writes — the-tenure-loop was sealed with a DEAD EYE. Its armed WATCHME held _TREE = 'commons' and censused only that tree, while the live face composes its session with tree='library' (LibrarianShim.__init__). Measured 2026-08-10: 88 rows live, {library: 84, founding: 4}, and 'commons' an ABSENT KEY — no row has ever existed there. So the instrument reported neither health nor decoration; it reported nothing, and silence at a watch is indistinguishable from health. That is how a hollow watch passed a PROVED crossing. BOTH of the ticket's own falsifiers were REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT rather than by confidence: MISAIMED died at survey (all four RATIFIED rows — 3 earned, 1 refuted — sit in 'library', and the charter says 'commons' zero times against 'library' 19), and INSUFFICIENT died at build (one line changed and the census returned 80 hypothesis / 3 earned / 1 refuted, 9 crossings, every earned node spanning exactly 2 distinct questions = PROMOTION_THRESHOLD, so promotion is real and not hollow). THE TOOTH WAS WRITTEN FIRST AND RED — exit 1, its failure text naming both ends of the seam — and the identical bytes (sha256 78ccd412…) went green after; re-verified by stashing the repair and re-running the current tooth, which reds again. It reads the face's tree from inspect.signature(LibrarianShim.__init__) and never from a literal, so it reds on DISAGREEMENT and survives both ends moving to a third tree together. Five teeth: the seam, non-vacuity (a neighbour tree's row must NOT be seen — a pass-through census fails this while passing the seam), the predicates fed by the census, THE DEFECT'S OWN SIGNATURE (a severed census stands both predicates DOWN in silence, never loud — kept so it cannot return unnamed), and the probe still a reader. Sealed netns, seal measured (1.1.1.1:53 gone inside, socket through). Both predicates still stand down and now for TRACEABLE reasons: 9 < 20 crossings (young tree), 0 shards past a 14-day horizon whose oldest row is 13 days — UNRIPE, not unreachable; it ripens tomorrow. THE HONEST GAP, stated: done here is 'the instrument measures', NOT 'the tenure loop is healthy'. This voyage closes green with the efficacy question still open, which is the probe's job over the next crossings, not this repair's.
